claims: Electric vehicles (EVs) are cars powered by electric motors and rechargeable battery packs rather than gasoline engines.
Electric vehicles offer zero tailpipe emissions.
Electric vehicles have improved range of 150-400+ miles.
BEVs use large battery packs to power electric motors.
BEVs require plugging in to charge.
The primary types of electric vehicles include Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs) and Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs).
PHEVs combine batteries with a gas engine.
Toyota is expanding its EV lineup.
Toyota is targeting multiple models by 2027.
Key EV models include the Tesla Model 3 and Model Y, Hyundai IONIQ 6, Nissan LEAF, and Chevrolet Bolt.
EVs can be charged at home using a standard outlet.
Specialized charging equipment provides faster charging for EVs.
